meta.system: Dấu Việt Global — Phase 05.1 Map Density, State & Accessibility QA

density.world_country: PASS — clusters + featured destinations only; no marker carpet
density.city_place: PASS_WITH_RULE — individual markers allowed, labels must be priority-gated/collision-managed

states.selected: PASS — scale 1.12–1.18 + stronger boundary, glyph unchanged
states.visited: PASS — check/stamp + accessible state, not color only
states.unavailable: PASS_WITH_RULE — neutral treatment must include reason/explanation

labels.font: must not shrink below Phase 03 tokens to force fit

clusters.dense_overlap: PASS_WITH_RULE — use zoom/spiderfy/list; never stack unreadable counts
clusters.keyboard: cluster control must be focusable if interactive

themes.dark: PASS_WITH_RULE — preserve >=3:1 essential marker/glyph boundaries and avoid low-contrast basemap interference

accessibility.touch_target: PASS — 44x44 CSS px minimum independent of visual marker size
accessibility.keyboard: PASS_WITH_RULE — interactive markers/clusters focusable in logical map/list order
accessibility.screen_reader: PASS_WITH_RULE — accessible name includes entity type + name + state
accessibility.reduced_motion: PASS — scale/cluster transitions may be disabled
accessibility.graphics_contrast: PASS_WITH_RULE — essential graphics >=3:1 against adjacent map surface

production_corrections: At City/Place density, label visibility must be priority-based and collision-managed; never show every label simultaneously.
On dark or visually busy basemaps, marker container needs a contrast keyline/halo when required to maintain >=3:1 boundary contrast.
Cluster expansion must choose zoom, spiderfy, or accessible list; overlapping clusters may not remain as unreadable stacked circles.
Unavailable markers need an explanatory reason in tooltip/panel/accessibility text.
Historical uncertainty must use dashed/explicit uncertainty semantics, not opacity alone.
Map keyboard navigation should expose a synchronized accessible entity list where direct spatial tab order becomes impractical.

decision.condition: include the six implementation rules above as part of the locked spatial system
